tiler.apple-numerical-behaviour/v7: -target: MTLCompileOptions has no target property; the runtime compiler targets the device and OS it is running on, which is why a runtime case is attributed to the family whose execution environment compiled it

-ffp-contract: MTLCompileOptions has no contraction property; the source-level `#pragma METAL fp contract(...)` is accepted by this front end but changing the source would break the byte-identical pairing the comparison depends on
-O0/-O1/-O3/-Os: MTLLibraryOptimizationLevel offers Default and Size only, so four of the five offline optimization levels have no runtime counterpart
